name: text-size
title: In-app text size
summary: A text-size setting in Account (90–130%) that every `AppText` and `FormField` follows, multiplied with the phone's own font scale and capped per variant so layouts hold.
when: Reading-heavy apps, older users, or a design whose type runs small.
claudeRules: Text sizes come from `TypeScale` × the in-app text size; raw `Text`/`TextInput` must use `scaleFontSize` and `fontScaleCap` (`src/lib/text-scale.ts`). Text in a fixed-size box passes an explicit `fontSize` and is exempt.
